title: Analytic: lasing threshold of a lossy cavity filled with gain (FDTD, gain_medium)
description:
A 1D cavity between PEC walls on x (y-periodic, 25 nm cells) filled with eps 1 and sigma_e = 50 S/m everywhere rings down after a gaussian line-source pulse; a gain_medium on every cell (four-level, gamma = 1e14 rad/s, tau_21 = 1 ns) has its line centre on the discrete mode-6 resonance (lambda_mode ~0.992 um) and starts with N2 - N1 = r_inv dN_th (no pump; dN_th = sigma gamma / kappa, kappa = 6 pi eps0 c^3 / (omega^2 tau_21)); sweep r_inv = 0..0.8.
Analytic (uniform filling: omega^2 eps(omega) = c^2 K^2 for the mode, gain chi = j kappa dN / (eps0 gamma omega) at line centre): field decay rate Im omega = sigma / (2 eps0) - kappa dN / (2 eps0 gamma) = sigma (1 - r_inv) / (2 eps0), so the decay falls linearly to 0 at the lasing threshold r_inv = 1; Q = omega / (2 Im omega); the resonance stays at lambda_mode (no pulling at line centre). lambda_mode uses the discrete FDTD dispersion of K = 6 pi / (Lx - dx) (E_z = 0 at the outermost cell centres).
Sweep tab: gamma_decay (2 pi x the resonance_monitor frequency_imag of row 0, the only resonance in 0.93-1.08 um) with its dashed reference line, which extrapolates to 0 at r_inv = 1 (the threshold); cold_decay (dashed) = the no-gain level sigma / (2 eps0); Q_mode (q_factor) and lambda_res with references; the table column em.ring frequency_imag (series frequency_imag_1) carries the same dashed line divided by 2 pi (threshold_line).
Curves & tables tab: the resonance table of the last value.
Expected: gamma_decay within ~0.7 % of the cold rate, an offset, so ~2 % relative at r_inv = 0.8 where the decay is 5x smaller (leap-frog Lorentz line ~(omega dt)^2, conductivity stepping, population drift through tau_21 ~1.6e-3 over the 1.6 ps run), lambda_res ~1e-4.

parameters.name: r_inv
parameters.description: initial inversion as a fraction of the line-centre threshold dN_th (sweep 0..0.8)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain length along x (pec on both x faces, 120 cells)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: periodic y period (4 cells)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: sigma_cav
parameters.description: conductivity of every cell [S/m] (cold field decay sigma / (2 eps0) = 2.8e12 1/s)

parameters.name: m_mode
parameters.description: longitudinal mode number of the cavity resonance studied

parameters.name: L_cav
parameters.description: cavity length between the E_z = 0 planes (centres of the outermost cells) [m]

parameters.name: K_mode
parameters.description: mode wavenumber [1/m]

parameters.name: dt_fdtd
parameters.description: FDTD time step at courant 0.99 on square cells [s]

parameters.name: omega_mode
parameters.description: discrete FDTD angular frequency of mode m_mode [rad/s]

parameters.name: lambda_mode
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the discrete mode (gain line centre)

parameters.name: gamma_line
parameters.description: gain linewidth [rad/s]

parameters.name: tau_21
parameters.description: upper lasing level lifetime [s] (sets kappa)

parameters.name: kappa_gain
parameters.description: gain coupling kappa [C^2/kg] of the polarisation equation

parameters.name: dN_th
parameters.description: line-centre threshold inversion [1/m^3] (~4e21)

parameters.name: G_cold
parameters.description: cold-cavity field decay rate [1/s]

parameters.name: G_ref
parameters.description: analytic field decay rate with gain [1/s]

parameters.name: Q_ref
parameters.description: analytic quality factor omega / (2 gamma)

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: line source x (cell 50 centre, an antinode of mode 6)

parameters.name: x_probe
parameters.description: resonance monitor x (cell 30 centre, an antinode)

parameters.name: t_run
parameters.description: study duration [s]
